text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Annual number of people left homeless by all natural disasters

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: Disasters include events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods.

tspan.tspan: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting

text.tspan: improvements. The latest year may be incomplete due to reporting delays.
